about: Every place the mod touches KH2 (Steam Global, exe sha256 9002b2de6a1f91a790bd0673de125d1cf833f7942bfec827cdcf6ba64d5849ed). RVAs are relative to KINGDOM HEARTS II FINAL MIX.exe. kind=func rows are native functions the mod hooks or calls and are byte-checked before use; kind=data rows are memory it reads or writes.

rows.use: hooked: the mod's per-frame game-thread tick runs before the native loop
rows.evidence: kh2-multiplayer pointer_map (CONFIRMED) + prologue bytes read from this exe

rows.use: hooked: when KH2 finds one of our frozen actors frozen, the hook also sets its 'updated this frame' bit (+0x9B8 0x800) so KH2's deferred-child loop (0x3BF660) can finish
rows.evidence: disassembled here: 0x3BFD30 calls it first; ripsample showed the loop at 0x3BF660-0x3BF6FD spinning when a frozen parent never set 0x800

rows.use: called to reload a room with an encounter battle program and to return to the field
rows.evidence: kh2-multiplayer pointer_map (GHIDRA+LIVE, 50 warps) + prologue bytes read from this exe

rows.use: called to apply spell damage (negative) and healing (positive) through the game's own HP path
rows.evidence: kh2-multiplayer EntityHook notes (VUH-1501) + prologue bytes read from this exe

rows.use: called to turn an actor's next-handle into a pointer while walking the active list
rows.evidence: disassembled here: used by 0x3BF7A0 list walk

rows.use: first actor of the active actor list
rows.evidence: kh2-multiplayer KH2Offsets (CONFIRMED); same rip target seen in 0x3BF605

rows.use: freezes whole actor groups (bit n = group n) to make turns
rows.evidence: disassembled here: 0x3BFA40 tests bit [group] where group=0x3B5DC0(actor)

rows.use: room is live (1) or loading (0)
nonzero while a cutscene timeline runs: no encounters, no turn logic
nonzero during scripted events: no encounters
0xFF when no menu is open
0 when the pause menu may open; read only to know the game is paused
2 = forced (story/boss) battle

rows.signature: u8 world,u8 room,u16 door,u16 map,u16 btl,u16 evt
rows.use: current location and programs

rows.signature: unit slot: +0x0 HP i32, +0x4 MaxHP i32
rows.use: Roxas HP and max HP
inventory counts (Potion +0x3580, Ether +0x3582, Hi-Potion +0x3581)
next actor in the active list

rows.signature: qword -> objentry row (+0 id u32, +4 type u8, +8 name char[32])
rows.use: who an actor is: type 0 player, 1 party, 3 boss, 4 mob

rows.signature: qword -> status (+0 HP i32, +4 MaxHP i32)
rows.use: enemy HP for the turn order and victory check
Roxas steps for the encounter meter; position restore after a battle

rows.signature: u32 motion id (0 idle,1 walk,2 run)
rows.use: an attack turn ends when Roxas returns to idle/run after hitting
hooked to draw the FFX-style battle UI with Dear ImGui (DX11 and DX12)
hooked only to learn the game's DX12 queue for ImGui

hooked: before KH2 eases its camera toward the raw eye (+0x64/+0x74) and look-at (+0x84/+0x94) targets, the hook writes the FFX battle camera there, so the camera glides to it and the player can't turn it
rows.evidence: disassembled here: the per-frame camera task 0x164860 -> 0x166100 ends with 0x165700(cam), which smooths +0x08/+0x18 from +0x84/+0x64 via 0x165BD0

rows.use: hooked: during battles the hook clears raw pad slot 0 after KH2 reads it (no walking, camera, KH2 menus) and presses Cross for the FFX Attack
rows.evidence: kh2-multiplayer pointer_map (GHIDRA, CONFIRMED) + prologue bytes read from this exe

rows.use: called (actor, yaw in xmm1) to turn battlers toward the other line; yaw = atan2(dx, dz)
rows.evidence: disassembled here: writes the rotation at +0x680 and target yaw +0x7A8; kh2-multiplayer ScriptMirror maps obj_set_rot to it

rows.use: pointer to KH2's input struct; raw pad slot 0 is at +0x18 (u16 PS2 buttons, then right and left stick bytes, 0x80 = centre)
KH2's camera: +0x08 eased look-at, +0x18 eased eye, +0x64/+0x74 raw eye, +0x84/+0x94 raw look-at
called (actor, record) to run a KH2 command (magic, item, guard) on a battler: record +0 u16 command id, +8 target actor handle, +0x14 -1
rows.evidence: disassembled here: dispatches on the command table's Execute (+2) field; magic stores the spell (+0xDA8) and the target from record +8; kh2-multiplayer CLONE_NEUTRAL_INPUT notes it runs FIELD_COMMAND's record

rows.use: called (command id) for the command table row: +2 Execute, +28 MP cost
rows.evidence: disassembled here: 0x3D6FC0 calls it with the record's id and reads +2
